doc.brief: Arranges child widgets into a single row or column.
doc.md:
Arranges child widgets into a single row or column.

Whether it is a row or column depends on the value of its
[`Orientable:orientation`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Orientable#property:orientation) property. Within the other
dimension, all children are allocated the same size. The
[`Widget:halign`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:halign) and [`Widget:valign`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:valign)
properties can be used on the children to influence their allocation.

Use repeated calls to [`Box.append()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:append) to pack widgets into a
`GtkBox` from start to end. Use [`Box.remove()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:remove) to remove widgets
from the `GtkBox`. [`Box.insert_child_after()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:insert_child_after) can be used to add
a child at a particular position.

Use [`Box.set_homogeneous()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:set_homogeneous) to specify whether or not all children
of the `GtkBox` are forced to get the same amount of space.

Use [`Box.set_spacing()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:set_spacing) to determine how much space will be minimally
placed between all children in the `GtkBox`. Note that spacing is added
*between* the children.

Use [`Box.reorder_child_after()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:reorder_child_after) to move a child to a different
place in the box.

# CSS nodes

`GtkBox` uses a single CSS node with name box.

# Accessibility

Until GTK 4.10, `GtkBox` used the [`AccessibleRole.group`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:group) role.

Starting from GTK 4.12, `GtkBox` uses the [`AccessibleRole.generic`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:generic) role.

append.brief: Adds a child at the end.
append.md: Adds a child at the end.

get_homogeneous.brief: Returns whether the box is homogeneous.
get_homogeneous.md:
Returns whether the box is homogeneous.

In a homogeneous box all children are the same size.

insert_child_after.brief: Inserts a child at a specific position.
insert_child_after.md:
Inserts a child at a specific position.

The child is added after `sibling` in the list of `box` children.

If `sibling` is `NULL`, the `child` is placed at the beginning.

prepend.brief: Adds a child at the beginning.
prepend.md: Adds a child at the beginning.

remove.brief: Removes a child widget from the box.
remove.md:
Removes a child widget from the box.

The child must have been added before with
[`Box.append()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:append), [`Box.prepend()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:prepend), or
[`Box.insert_child_after()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Box#method:insert_child_after).

reorder_child_after.brief: Moves a child to a different position.
reorder_child_after.md:
Moves a child to a different position.

The child is moved to the position after `sibling` in the list
of `box` children.

If `sibling` is `NULL`, the child is placed at the beginning.

set_baseline_child.brief: Sets the baseline child of a box.
set_baseline_child.md:
Sets the baseline child of a box.

This affects only vertical boxes.

set_baseline_position.brief: Sets the baseline position of a box.
set_baseline_position.md:
Sets the baseline position of a box.

This affects only horizontal boxes with at least one baseline
aligned child. If there is more vertical space available than
requested, and the baseline is not allocated by the parent then
`position` is used to allocate the baseline with respect to the
extra space available.

set_homogeneous.brief: Sets whether or not all children are given equal space in the box.
set_homogeneous.md:
Sets whether or not all children are given equal space
in the box.

set_spacing.brief: Sets the number of pixels to place between children.
set_spacing.md: Sets the number of pixels to place between children.

baseline-child.brief: The position of the child that determines the baseline.
baseline-child.md:
The position of the child that determines the baseline.

This is only relevant if the box is in vertical orientation.

baseline-position.brief: How to position baseline-aligned widgets if extra space is available.
baseline-position.md: How to position baseline-aligned widgets if extra space is available.

homogeneous.brief: Whether the children should all be the same size.
homogeneous.md: Whether the children should all be the same size.

spacing.brief: The amount of space between children.
spacing.md: The amount of space between children.
